name: spanish-intake-skill
description: Spanish Intake Skill — Claude Desktop plugin. Conducts bilingual (English/Spanish) client intake and communication: turns Spanish-language intake notes or a voicemail transcript into a structured English intake summary for the file, and turns an English draft communication into a natural Spanish version — flagging any ambiguous translation for the attorney's confirmation rather than guessing.

scripts.build: npm run validate && npm run pack && npm run checksum
scripts.release: npm run build && gh release create v$npm_package_version spanish-intake-skill-v$npm_package_version.zip spanish-intake-skill-v$npm_package_version.zip.sha256 --title "v$npm_package_version" --notes-file RELEASE.md
